      public TailCutLayer.TailCutLayerBuilder percentile(int percentile)
      Sets the latency percentile used to calculate the deadline.

      Returns:
      this builder

      IllegalArgumentException - if the percentile is outside the allowed range

    • safetyFactor

      public TailCutLayer.TailCutLayerBuilder safetyFactor(double safetyFactor)
      Sets the multiplier applied to the observed latency percentile.
      Parameters:
      safetyFactor - the multiplier, from 1.0 to 5.0 inclusive
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the multiplier is NaN or outside the allowed range

      public TailCutLayer.TailCutLayerBuilder window(Duration window)
      Sets the sliding window for collecting latency statistics.

      Returns:
      this builder
